free_tier.stated: No free plan on n8n Cloud: a 14-day trial with Pro features and a limit of 1000 executions, no credit card required; Starter is 20€/mo billed annually for 2.5K workflow executions
free_tier.notes: When the trial ends without an upgrade, n8n deletes the instance; workflows can be downloaded for 90 days after. The n8n public REST API is not available on the trial. The free Community Edition is self-hosted only: the user installs and runs it on a rented or free machine.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the pages read

retention.stated: the trial instance is deleted at the end of the trial; workflows can be downloaded for 90 days after

egress.terms: not applicable: workflows call third-party APIs; no traffic allowance is published

interface_detail: the n8n public REST API is on Cloud Starter, Pro and Enterprise and on every self-hosted edition, but not on the free trial; during the trial workflows are built in the web editor
tooling: the n8n web editor; the REST API and the n8n API node on paid Cloud plans. As a last resort, the Community Edition, which the user installs and runs on a rented or free machine.
chaining: A 14-day trial only; for a lasting free automation layer the hosted free tiers come first (Pipedream Connect, Zapier Free, Inngest Free), and the self-installed Community Edition last.

limits.value: the trial instance is deleted when the 14-day trial ends without an upgrade

limits_note: Trial compute matches the Starter plan.
binding_note: The trial ends after 14 days with the instance deleted, whatever the execution count.

identity_cost.detail: The Cloud sign-up page asks for an email address (one rendering labels it Company email) and then continues; the trial needs no credit card. Fields after the email step are unverified.

reliability_note: The trial instance is deleted when the trial ends without an upgrade.
confidence_note: Trial terms, plan prices and API availability are read on first-party pages; nothing behind the sign-up was read.
